summary: @servicetitan/anvil-css-utilities 14.5.8 executes obfuscated payload via downloaded Bun runtime at install
details: Package advertises itself as CSS utilities but its package.json declares preinstall=`node setup.mjs`. setup.mjs downloads the Bun runtime from oven-sh/bun GitHub releases, extracts it to a temporary directory, chmods it executable, and then invokes it against a sibling file math_init.js. math_init.js is a 727KB heavily obfuscated blob (single large mixed constant array `n7gIxM=[...]`, string-array rotation function performing push/shift, custom-alphabet decoder `hc1jfK9`, randomized identifiers) whose decoded contents are executed with full runtime privileges on the installer's machine at install time. The behavior is unrelated to CSS. The manifest declares `files: ["dist", "readme.md"]` and `main: index.js`, yet index.js is absent and the payload files setup.mjs and math_init.js ship at the tarball root outside the declared file list — consistent with injection into a legitimate ServiceTitan package name. The Bun runtime is used specifically to execute the obfuscated sibling payload, bypassing Node-based install-time scanners.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
